faq.q: Does SnapStats publish a townhome-only median for Maple Ridge?
faq.a: No. SnapStats splits Maple Ridge only as Detached versus "Condos & Townhomes" combined, and publishes medians at community level only — the September 2026 combined median is $525,000 ($432/sq ft, 94% sale-to-list, 49 days on market). There is no townhome-only median in the permitted source (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Where is most of Maple Ridge's attached stock?
faq.a: In the combined Condos & Townhomes counts for September 2026, East Central (120 listings) and West Central (78) dominate; the townhome areas the page leads with are thinner — Cottonwood 34, Albion 18, Silver Valley 15 and Southwest 8 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: How do Maple Ridge townhome buyers commute?
faq.a: The West Coast Express runs weekday trains between Waterfront (downtown Vancouver) and Mission City, stopping at Port Haney Station (22300 River Road), with Maple Meadows Station serving the city's west side; Haney Place Exchange is the bus hub, including the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Maple Ridge freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
